scope: Offline/app-import readiness contract for Alpha-safe mission pack construction.

context_dependence_test.product_question: Clarify whether the listener responds to the music itself, the surrounding context, or both.
context_dependence_test.required_source_opportunity_purity: single coherent opportunity preferred; top-window mixing allowed only when all source opportunities share the same target uncertainty.
context_dependence_test.anchor_requirements: At least one visible-evidence anchor or low-risk representative.
context_dependence_test.probe_requirements: Context-heavy and context-light items must be balanced.
context_dependence_test.comparator_control_requirements: At least one comparator or control isolates the relevant context dimension.
context_dependence_test.source_opportunity_mixing_policy: Allowed only for same target/context question with multi_source_route=true and explanation.
revise_conditions: overly safe with no context contrast
context_dependence_test.app_import_eligibility_rules: Eligible when route is coherent, concrete, and no ordinary unresolved playback items remain.

boundary_test.product_question: Find the edge between a known positive area and a nearby uncertain or mixed area without making the route punitive.
boundary_test.required_source_opportunity_purity: Pair target IDs must match the source opportunity pair.
boundary_test.anchor_requirements: Two likely-safe anchors from the positive side.
boundary_test.probe_requirements: Boundary items must test a specific edge, not random contrast.
boundary_test.comparator_control_requirements: Comparator/control must clarify the differentiating dimension.
boundary_test.source_opportunity_mixing_policy: Normally disallowed; allowed only for same pair target and explicit multi_source_route reason.
rejection_conditions: anchor fails thesis with multiple high-risk probes
boundary_test.app_import_eligibility_rules: Eligible only with bounded contrast and a clear one-sentence explanation.

bridge_test.product_question: Test whether a known positive source area can carry into an under-tested target through a plausible path.
bridge_test.required_source_opportunity_purity: Source and target endpoints must match source opportunity endpoint refs.
bridge_test.anchor_requirements: One source-side anchor grounded in visible evidence.
bridge_test.probe_requirements: Target probes must use low-to-medium risk paths.
bridge_test.comparator_control_requirements: At least one comparator/control keeps source-to-target continuity interpretable.
bridge_test.source_opportunity_mixing_policy: Allowed only across compatible bridge opportunities sharing the same source or target endpoint.
bridge_test.app_import_eligibility_rules: Eligible when continuity is explicit and target risk remains bounded.

archetype_depth_test.product_question: Test whether the listener likes deeper or less obvious material inside an already promising archetype.
archetype_depth_test.required_source_opportunity_purity: Single archetype target preferred; variants must preserve provenance to the same base target.
archetype_depth_test.anchor_requirements: One visible anchor or strong representative.
archetype_depth_test.probe_requirements: Deeper candidates must remain plausible; no forced negative probe.
archetype_depth_test.source_opportunity_mixing_policy: Allowed only for same archetype base target and explicit reason.
archetype_depth_test.app_import_eligibility_rules: Eligible only with strict negative budget and coherent depth progression.

gateway_test.product_question: Use a low-risk entry point to introduce an under-tested family or archetype.
gateway_test.required_source_opportunity_purity: One under-tested target with a clean gateway and representative follow-up.
revise_conditions: gateway does not cohere with representative
gateway_test.app_import_eligibility_rules: Optional Alpha-active when low risk and concrete playback refs exist.

artist_depth_test.rationale: Deferred for Alpha auto-import; requires stricter artist-specific construction before automation.
artist_depth_test.app_import_eligibility_rules: Blocked from automatic Alpha import until a stricter mission-specific construction contract is accepted.

album_container_test.rationale: Deferred for Alpha auto-import; requires stricter album-container construction before automation.
album_container_test.app_import_eligibility_rules: Blocked from automatic Alpha import until a stricter mission-specific construction contract is accepted.

false_nearby_test.rationale: Deferred for Alpha auto-import except manual review because the negative-risk profile is high.
false_nearby_test.app_import_eligibility_rules: Blocked from automatic Alpha import until a stricter mission-specific construction contract is accepted.

evidence_repair_test.rationale: Deferred for Alpha auto-import until repair-specific route policy exists.
evidence_repair_test.app_import_eligibility_rules: Blocked from automatic Alpha import until a stricter mission-specific construction contract is accepted.

exception_scope_test.rationale: Deferred for Alpha auto-import until scope-isolation policy exists.
exception_scope_test.app_import_eligibility_rules: Blocked from automatic Alpha import until a stricter mission-specific construction contract is accepted.
